Pylontech / YD/T 1363.3 framed telemetry request (CID2 0x42, address 0x02, INFO 0x02) sent by Maavey to the RS485 port of the LVESS15 pack.

Answer of the LVESS15 pack to that request: VER 0x20, address 0x02, CID1 0x46, RTN 0x00 and an empty INFO (LENID 0), i.e. no telemetry. Single observation; nothing else in any source shows a Deye pack speaking this framing.

Handshake start written to 0xFFF2 for battery 1 of the source (advertised name anonymized by the source to BAT00000000000001): 01 FF "random", 16 ASCII hex characters, CRC-16/MODBUS of everything before it, low byte first.

Handshake answer notified on 0xFFF2 for battery 1: 01 FF "cipher", one AES-128-CBC block (key = first 16 hex characters of SHA-256(name + randomStr) as ASCII, IV = 16 ASCII "0") of randomStr, CRC-16/MODBUS trailer. The ciphertexts were re-keyed by the source to the anonymized name.

Handshake start written to 0xFFF2 for battery 2 of the source (advertised name anonymized by the source to BAT00000000000002): 01 FF "random", 16 ASCII hex characters, CRC-16/MODBUS of everything before it, low byte first.

Handshake answer notified on 0xFFF2 for battery 2: 01 FF "cipher", one AES-128-CBC block (key = first 16 hex characters of SHA-256(name + randomStr) as ASCII, IV = 16 ASCII "0") of randomStr, CRC-16/MODBUS trailer. The ciphertexts were re-keyed by the source to the anonymized name.

Handshake start written to 0xFFF2 for battery 3 of the source (advertised name anonymized by the source to BAT00000000000003): 01 FF "random", 16 ASCII hex characters, CRC-16/MODBUS of everything before it, low byte first.

Handshake answer notified on 0xFFF2 for battery 3: 01 FF "cipher", one AES-128-CBC block (key = first 16 hex characters of SHA-256(name + randomStr) as ASCII, IV = 16 ASCII "0") of randomStr, CRC-16/MODBUS trailer. The ciphertexts were re-keyed by the source to the anonymized name.
Handshake acknowledgement written after a matching cipher block: 01 FF "result", status 0x01, CRC-16/MODBUS trailer. From here on every frame is AES-128-CBC encrypted.

Encrypted request 0x02 written by the Deye Cloud app: AES-128-CBC with PKCS#7 padding of the lowercase ASCII hex text of the AA 55 frame (18 characters, two blocks). Session key of the first handshake vector; re-keyed by the source.

Encrypted answer 0x02 of a Deye SE-F16-C: AES-128-CBC with PKCS#7 padding of the AA 55 frame bytes (no hex text layer on answers). The plaintext is byte for byte the RS485 answer 0x02 of the SE-G5.1 Pro (no alarm).
Encrypted answer 0x04 (cell voltages) of a Deye SE-F16-C, session randomStr 08D7D740BF98D512 (same anonymized name). 81 byte AA 55 frame in 96 bytes of ciphertext; 72 data bytes as on RS485.
